title: Complete Equivariant Borsuk-Ulam for Compact Lie Groups

problemStatement.formal: \text{For a compact Lie group } G \text{ acting linearly on } V, W \text{ with } V^G = 0,\; \dim V > \dim W \implies \text{every } G\text{-equivariant map } f: S(V) \to W \text{ has a zero.}
problemStatement.plain: The classical Borsuk-Ulam theorem says a continuous antipodal (Z/2-equivariant) map

currentState: SOLVED (axiomatized): free-involution Z/2 Borsuk-Ulam formalized in Proofs/BorsukUlamOQ02OQ02WIP01.lean; 0 sorry, 1 axiom; classical HasAntipodalPair recovered non-circularly.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE (axiomatized): replaced parent EquivariantBorsukUlam := True placeholder with real Z/2 free-involution Borsuk-Ulam; single topological axiom; classical BorsukUlam.HasAntipodalPair re-derived as instance (verified non-circular via #print axioms).
builtItems: IsEquivariant plus id/comp closure: typeclass-free equivariant map framework (lines 67-81)
axiom borsuk_ulam_free_involution: the Z/2 free-involution BU / Dold input (line 100)
equivariant_borsuk_ulam: zero-existence for arbitrary free involutions (line 120)
EquivariantBorsukUlamStatement plus _holds: real Prop replacing parent := True (lines 143,157)
insights: The parent placeholder EquivariantBorsukUlam := True can be completed honestly for the Z/2 case by isolating the deep input as a single named axiom (same discipline as classical BorsukUlam file), not the full ~2000-line compact-Lie-group stack.
Free-involution formulation strictly generalizes classical antipodal BU: axiom + theorem hold for ANY free involution sigma (sigma^2=id, sigma x != x on sphere), of which x -> -x is one instance.
Recovery verified non-circular: #print axioms classical_of_free_involution lists borsuk_ulam_free_involution but NOT BorsukUlam.no_continuous_odd_nonzero_on_sphere.
Typeclass-free equivariance (explicit action function G->V->V) avoids all SMul instance plumbing and lets the antipodal instantiation go through directly.
eq_zero_of_neg_eq: -x=x implies x=0 in a real vector space via two_smul + smul_eq_zero (not add_self_eq_zero, which resolves to a semiring lemma wrong for EuclideanSpace).
mathlibGaps: Equivariant algebraic topology (Z/2-equivariant no-retraction S^n -> S^(n-1) / Dold dimension bound) is not in Mathlib; the reason borsuk_ulam_free_involution is axiomatized rather than proved.
nextSteps: Discharge borsuk_ulam_free_involution via Mathlib algebraic topology (RP^n fundamental group / degree).
Extend the explicit-action framework to free Z/p (Yang) by replacing sigma^2=id with an order-p free action.
Bridge IsEquivariant to Mathlib Representation/MulAction so the parent compact-Lie placeholder inherits these lemmas.
